findings.title: Full replay bypasses transition admission and loses reopen strengthening
findings.observation: Special implementation, verification, integration, operational, supersession, and reopen admission was enforced before append but not by the authoritative replay reducer. Transition history also omitted regression_strengthening.
findings.required_repair: Enforce semantic transition admission inside the shared reducer and retain transition-specific evidence in projected history.

findings.title: Legacy control addition can re-pollute a typed surface
findings.observation: surface_controls_added accepted arbitrary strings after surface_inventory_revised established typed control_records.
findings.required_repair: Require typed records for additions to an already typed surface and update known_controls and control_records atomically.

findings.title: Advertised file bounds were checked after unbounded reads
findings.observation: Compact head, full snapshot, and recovery ledger content were materialized before enforcing their byte bounds.
findings.required_repair: Open regular files, fstat before allocation, and read at most maximum+1 bytes.

findings.title: Batch iterable was materialized before its event bound
findings.observation: append_events called list(entries) before enforcing MAX_BATCH_EVENTS.
findings.required_repair: Consume at most MAX_BATCH_EVENTS+1 entries before admission.

findings.title: Dashboard collapsed checkpoint recovery states to invalid
findings.observation: Checkpoint disagreement did fail closed, but the dashboard did not distinguish checkpoint_stale from recovery_required.
findings.required_repair: Return typed recovery status and an explicit bounded recovery action.

verification_gaps.required_test: Incremental and full replay equality across every supported event type.
Snapshot/head publication failure followed by exactly-once recovery into a coherent checkpoint.
Concurrent dashboard reads return coherent data or a typed fail-closed recovery state.
Replay admission, typed-surface legacy-add refusal, and oversized recovery-source refusal.

documented_limitations.detail: Project-local self-hashes and filesystem metadata are not an external trust anchor; coordinated privileged replacement remains outside this trust model.
Batch append is ordered rather than transactionally all-or-nothing; every complete hash-valid prefix remains authoritative after a crash.
POSIX directory fsync is used where supported; equivalent power-loss directory durability is platform-dependent on Windows.
